snippet.title: Cats in the Shell PV
snippet.description:
Cats in the Shell, a mech-building roguelike auto battler. Take the helm of giant combat machines as feline fighters on PC via Steam Early Access in Q4 2026. 
Hello dear cat pilots! We're Raven Studio, Cats in the Shell is the first indie game we’ve developed. Thanks for supporting us! 
steampage: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4688400/Cats_In_The_Shell/
